paired_order: alternate baseline-first/candidate-first by case index; same task/sources/model/seed/budgets
first_observation: no semantic reruns; first stdout/stderr/traces/resolver journal and START/FINISH preserved; operational failures separate and fail completeness

negative_prebinding: 6 information-missing/wrong-target scenarios are intentionally unproven target prebindings; original source quote display is diagnostic, never semantic-target-detection success
efficiency_report: actual response/failure trace events, usage/attempts/model identities, wall time, resolver calls; baseline helper0calls; no fabricated equal-cost baseline
state_isolation: new empty REASON_HOME for every individual CLI/probe/adviser invocation
freeze_reservation: unique push-only immutable freeze tag, run_attempt1; duplicate same-commit workflow push runs are rejected before credentials
immutable_execution: workflow copies frozen suite and workflow into read-only scratch; code/binary hashes checked before every invocation
